subject: Money
title: The Knights Templar Bank
description: A quick, practical guide to The Knights Templar Bank.

hook.text: Crusaders needed money in Jerusalem but carrying gold was deadly. The Knights Templar solved it.

buildup.text: Deposit gold in London, get a letter of credit, withdraw in Jerusalem. International banking in 1150 AD.

discovery.text: The Templars built a network across Europe and the Middle East. They held deposits for kings and popes.

twist.text: In 1307, King Philip IV of France owed them too much. He arrested them all on a Friday the 13th.

climax.text: The most powerful bank in medieval Europe was destroyed by a debtor who happened to be king.

punchline.text: Never lend to someone who owns the army.

quiz.question: What financial innovation did the Knights Templar introduce?
